mapper.select: SELECT f.id AS flight_id, f.code, f.region_dep, f.region_arr, f.datetime_dep, COUNT(o.id) AS order_count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN o.pay_status IN ('PAID', 'REFUNDED') THEN o.total_price ELSE 0 END), 0) AS revenue, (p.max_seat_first_class + p.max_seat_business_class + p.max_seat_economy_class) AS capacity FROM flight f LEFT JOIN plane p ON f.id_plane = p.id LEFT JOIN orders o ON o.id_flight = f.id AND o.order_status <> 'CANCELLED' GROUP BY f.id, f.code, f.region_dep, f.region_arr, f.datetime_dep, p.max_seat_first_class, p.max_seat_business_class, p.max_seat_economy_class ORDER BY order_count DESC, revenue DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN o.pay_status IN ('PAID', 'REFUNDED') THEN o.total_price ELSE 0 END), 0) AS total_revenue, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN o.pay_status = 'PAID' THEN o.total_price ELSE 0 END), 0) AS collected_revenue, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN o.pay_status = 'REFUNDED' THEN o.total_price ELSE 0 END), 0) AS refund_amount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_status = 'REFUNDED' THEN f.cancellation_fee ELSE 0 END), 0) AS cancellation_fee_income, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN o.pay_status = 'PAID' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS paid_order_count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_status = 'REFUNDED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS refund_count, COUNT(*) AS total_order_count FROM orders o LEFT JOIN flight f ON o.id_flight = f.id

SELECT ch.id AS channel_id, ch.channel_name, COUNT(o.id) AS order_count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN o.pay_status IN ('PAID', 'REFUNDED') THEN o.total_price ELSE 0 END), 0) AS revenue FROM channel ch LEFT JOIN orders o ON o.id_channel = ch.id GROUP BY ch.id, ch.channel_name ORDER BY revenue DESC, ch.id

SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.username, u.real_name, COUNT(o.id) AS order_count, COALESCE(SUM(o.total_price), 0) AS total_spend FROM sys_user u JOIN orders o ON o.id_user = u.id WHERE o.pay_status IN ('PAID', 'REFUNDED') GROUP BY u.id, u.username, u.real_name ORDER BY total_spend DESC, order_count DESC LIMIT #{limit}
